data.name: Aura of Heroism
data.description: At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of heroism %1 rounds per day. Using this ability is a swift action. Allies in the area are treated as if they were under the effects of heroism. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|DomainGloryLVL
